backtest.note: Result labels and prediction snapshots are isolated from Stable. No automatic promotion to Stable.

hidden_model_reverse.note: Descriptive reverse-engineering only. Small samples may be unstable. No signal may modify Stable without later validation and manual review.

stable_v3_calibration.system: HH520 Research Lab V1 - Stable V3 Calibration

output_error.note: Output errors are Research-only diagnostics; they do not auto-change Stable generation logic.

prediction_coverage.source_note: actual_score and actual_total_goals are Result Labels. predicted_score and predicted_total_goals are Prediction fields used only for accuracy evaluation. If raw predicted_score is absent, Research may derive it from pre-match 1X2 probabilities using the RESEARCH_POISSON_1X2 layer. predicted_total_goals is derived from predicted_score when no explicit total-goals prediction exists.
